title: Impactful dream survey - Results
content: So far we have had 95 responses to the survey we recently released about impactful and/or recurring dreams. Here is a link to those results. [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfJ\_VS-4DXra-WmbM8p9Gq4ZKfkoATnGd2n4DWnvx2AH6Qy-g/viewanalytics](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfJ_VS-4DXra-WmbM8p9Gq4ZKfkoATnGd2n4DWnvx2AH6Qy-g/viewanalytics) If you haven't taken the survey, you can take it here: [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfJ\_VS-4DXra-WmbM8p9Gq4ZKfkoATnGd2n4DWnvx2AH6Qy-g/viewform?usp=sharing](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfJ_VS-4DXra-WmbM8p9Gq4ZKfkoATnGd2n4DWnvx2AH6Qy-g/viewform?usp=sharing) Please do not share your email address or other identifying information in the survey as an overview of results will be visible to all respondents upon completion. Thank you all so much!
